notes: The application repository stores the frozen Phase 0 consumer mirror.
Phase 1 canonical ingestion contracts must be synchronized from the worker repository.
ADR approval does not authorize Phase 1 implementation or deployment.
The approved storage profile does not authorize GCS provisioning or IAM changes.
Local N-PORT, N-CEN, and RR1 bytes are preserved as originally published by the SEC; conditional source absence is not synthesized as an empty file.
Absolute workstation source paths are excluded from business identity.
